description: Repo-scale (makefile-buildsystem): the compiled-in version and a standalone version target must both read from the SAME VERSION file
prompts: Add a plain-text `VERSION` file at the repo root containing `1.2.0`. In the Makefile, read it once via `APP_VERSION := $(shell cat VERSION)` and embed it into the build via `-DAPP_VERSION=\"$(APP_VERSION)\"` in CFLAGS; update src/cli/main.c to print it (`printf("version: %s\n", APP_VERSION);`, with a fallback `#define APP_VERSION "unknown"` guarded by `#ifndef` for standalone compiles). ALSO add a `.PHONY` `version` target that prints the version - it must read the SAME `VERSION` file (e.g. `@cat VERSION`), not hardcode the number as a separate string literal, otherwise the compiled-in version and `make version`'s output can silently drift apart the next time VERSION is bumped.

test_setup_files.check_version_consistency.py:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

r = subprocess.run(['make', 'version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
assert r.returncode == 0, f'make version failed:\n{r.stdout}\n{r.stderr}'
assert r.stdout.strip() == '1.2.0', f"expected 'make version' to print 1.2.0, got {r.stdout!r}"

r2 = subprocess.run(['make', 'all'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
assert r2.returncode == 0, f'make all failed:\n{r2.stdout}\n{r2.stderr}'
run = subprocess.run(['./bin/app'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
assert 'version: 1.2.0' in run.stdout, run.stdout

# Bump VERSION and confirm `make version` tracks it (not hardcoded).
Path('VERSION').write_text('9.9.9\n', encoding='utf-8')
r3 = subprocess.run(['make', 'version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
assert r3.stdout.strip() == '9.9.9', (
    f"'make version' still prints {r3.stdout.strip()!r} after VERSION was bumped to 9.9.9 - "
    f'it must read the file live, not have the old number baked in')

print('PASS')

reference_solution.Makefile:
CC := gcc
APP_VERSION := $(shell cat VERSION)
CFLAGS := -std=c11 -Wall -MMD -MP -Isrc/core -Isrc/utils -DAPP_VERSION=\"$(APP_VERSION)\"

CORE_SRCS := $(wildcard src/core/*.c)
UTILS_SRCS := $(wildcard src/utils/*.c)
CLI_SRCS := $(wildcard src/cli/*.c)
SRCS := $(CORE_SRCS) $(UTILS_SRCS) $(CLI_SRCS)
OBJS := $(SRCS:.c=.o)
DEPS := $(OBJS:.o=.d)

BINDIR := bin
TARGET := $(BINDIR)/app

TEST_SRCS := $(CORE_SRCS) $(UTILS_SRCS) tests/test_calc.c
TEST_TARGET := $(BINDIR)/test_calc

.PHONY: all clean test version

all: $(TARGET)

$(TARGET): $(OBJS) | $(BINDIR)
	$(CC) $(OBJS) -o $(TARGET)

%.o: %.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

$(BINDIR):
	mkdir -p $(BINDIR)

version:
	@cat VERSION

test: $(TEST_TARGET)
	./$(TEST_TARGET)

$(TEST_TARGET): $(TEST_SRCS) | $(BINDIR)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(TEST_SRCS) -o $(TEST_TARGET)

clean:
	rm -rf $(BINDIR) $(DEPS) $(OBJS)

-include $(DEPS)
